finding: PRINTED: 'Discard a card: This creature can't be blocked this turn.' ENGINE(observed): the discard COST resolves (Silk -> graveyard, hand empties), but the PREVENT_EFFECT 'can't be blocked' clause is silently dropped: the blocking ask is still offered to the opponent ('block vocab = (card:0, NONE)'), the Wall's forced block registers — 'blocked[pilf]: expected [], got [wall]' — and Ghostly Pilferer takes 1 and dies instead of dealing 3 (life stays 20). The activated ability costs a card and delivers nothing.
notes: Pilferer's two other printed abilities are triggers (untapped-pay-draw, cast-from-not-hand draw) — this card has exactly one activated ability and it is the broken one.
